cvStructure.issue: Your CV does not include a phone number, only an email, location and GitHub link.
cvStructure.suggestion: Add a phone number near your email and location so employers can reach you directly.

sectionOrganization.issue: "About Me" and "My Journey So Far" are personal, creative headings instead of standard ones an ATS looks for.
sectionOrganization.suggestion: Rename "About Me" to "Summary" and "My Journey So Far" to "Experience".

sectionOrganization.issue: Your AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and Scrum Fundamentals Certified certifications are listed inside the Skills section instead of their own section.
sectionOrganization.suggestion: Move both certifications into a separate "Certifications" section placed after Skills.

sectionOrganization.issue: Your experience entries are listed oldest first: Campus IT Help Desk, then Najm Logistics Solutions, then Rimal Tech.
sectionOrganization.suggestion: List them most recent first: Rimal Tech, then Najm Logistics Solutions, then Campus IT Help Desk.

keywordUsage.issue: Technology names are written inconsistently across your CV: "Reactjs" and "Postgress" in Maktabati, "React.JS" and "Javascript" in Souq Tracker, and "JS" in Skills.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Use the official forms consistently everywhere: "React", "JavaScript" and "PostgreSQL".

keywordUsage.issue: In the Najm Logistics Solutions entry, making the app check itself automatically every time code is saved describes continuous integration, but that term is never named.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Add the standard term, for example "set up continuous integration (CI) to run automated tests on every code change."

keywordUsage.issue: You built REST endpoints in both the Najm Logistics Solutions and Rimal Tech roles, but "REST APIs" is not listed in your Skills section.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Add "REST APIs" to your Skills section since you have demonstrated this in two roles.

readability.issue: The Najm Logistics Solutions entry is written as one long continuous first-person story instead of separate points.
readability.suggestion: Split it into short bullet points, each starting with an action verb such as "Learned", "Optimized", "Collaborated" or "Set up".

readability.issue: Your Summary and the Campus IT Help Desk bullets, like "Responsible for bugs" and "Meetings with team", list duties in vague words instead of action-driven statements.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite the summary with concrete skills and a clear goal, and turn the Campus IT Help Desk bullets into statements like "Resolved student support tickets" or "Tracked and fixed reported bugs".

readability.issue: The Najm Logistics Solutions entry says the page "it loads faster" without giving a specific result.
readability.suggestion: Add a number, for example "reduced load time by [percentage]".

contentFormatting.issue: The Najm Logistics Solutions dates read "Jun 2025 - Aug 2024", which shows an end date before the start date.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Correct the dates to the actual months you worked at Najm Logistics Solutions.
